context: Sho-young gets sunburn at the beach; Saito treats him.
purpose: Doctor caring for child summer mishap.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Doctor, it hurts—my sunburn really hurts.
lines.style: Small, pained voice. Tight at the edges from discomfort. A child's directness without drama. Trusting the doctor to fix it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 熱い感じ、ようけある?小児、よく出る症状や。
lines.en: That burning sensation—is it quite widespread? Children get that often, you know.
lines.style: Warm reassurance underneath clinical observation. Speaking to the child, not at him. Slight settling pause after the question, making room for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: My skin is so red—look, so much red!
lines.style: Urgent, pointing-energy. Still small but insistent. The worry of seeing something wrong on your own body.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 直ぐに、優しい薬、塗ってあげるね。
lines.en: I'll put some gentle medicine on it for you right now.
lines.style: Calm, capable hands in the voice. Warm promise. No rushed movements, just steady action beginning.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 気をつけないと、また、なるのね。
lines.en: So if I'm not careful, it could happen again, right?
lines.style: Quiet processing. A child following cause to effect. Not fearful—just learning. Checking his understanding with the adult.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: Yes. Rest in the shade, take your time with it.
lines.style: Simple instruction delivered with quiet firmness. Not commanding but clear. The kind of thing a child will remember.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Relief flooding in. Genuine gratitude, bright again now that help is here. The speed of a child's return to trust.
